Art & Culture.title: Vacheron Constantin Presents the ‘Explore All Ways Possible’ Heritage Exhibition in London
Art & Culture.text: SummaryVacheron Constantin hosts 'Explore All Ways Possible' exhibition in London, July 20 – Aug 1 ,2026.Showcases heritage watches inspired by geographical, cultural and technical exploration.Highlights include American 1921, Chronomètre Royal, Overseas II, reflecting creativity across eras.Vacheron Constantin has officially opened its new heritage exhibition titled Explore All Ways Possible in London. Running from July 20 to August 1, 2026, the temporary retrospective pays tribute to the global openness, artistic curiosity and cultural discovery that have driven the Swiss luxury watchmaker since its foundation in 1755. Heavily influenced by the early 19th-century trade voyages initiated by François Constantin, the exhibition maps out the brand’s history across geographical, cultural and technical frontiers, demonstrating how encounters with different territories have continuously pushed the boundaries of the decorative arts.The exhibition is structured around three themes: geographical exploration, with pieces like the robust Overseas models and Art Deco watches influenced by Far Eastern motifs; cultural exploration, featuring Métiers d’Art creations inspired by Japanese lacquerware and haute couture; and technical exploration, with innovations ranging from shuttered travel watches to the precision‑focused Chronomètre Royal. Together, these watches illustrate how encounters with diverse cultures and technical challenges have shaped the Maison’s aesthetic and horological mastery.Highlights include the robust 1907 Chronomètre Royal, an ultra-thin skeleton pocket watch from 1978 with a mother-of-pearl dial, the American 1921 - a cushion‑shaped wristwatch emblematic of the Roaring Twenties - as well as unusual 1930s "Jalousie" wristwatch models featuring mechanical shutters designed to protect the crystal during travel.Vacheron Constantin Bond Street37 Old Bond St, LondonW1S 4AB, United KingdomClick here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

Entertainment.title: Bethesda Confirms ‘Fallout 3’ and ‘New Vegas’ Remasters Alongside ‘Fallout 5’ and an Unannounced Obsidian Project
Entertainment.text: SummaryBethesda has officially confirmed that remasters of 'Fallout 3' and 'Fallout: New Vegas' are in active development, ending months of leaks and speculation'Fallout 5' remains the studio's "long-range destination," while a separate unannounced project is being developed in collaboration with Obsidian EntertainmentNo release dates were provided for any of the four projects, though Bethesda teased that something "special" is planned for the franchise's 30th anniversary in 2027Bethesda has confirmed that it is working on remasters of both Fallout 3 and Fallout: New Vegas, alongside continued development on Fallout 5 and a newly revealed collaboration with Obsidian Entertainment on an unannounced Fallout project.The confirmation arrives after an extended cycle of leaks and near-misses. A toy company inadvertently revealed the New Vegas remaster earlier this year, and a mysterious Fallout countdown in January fueled widespread speculation about a Fallout 3 remaster shadowdrop that never materialized. Reports subsequently indicated the Fallout 3 remaster remained in "active development" despite the missed window. Until this blog post, Bethesda had never publicly acknowledged any of the remaster projects.The language in the announcement is carefully staged. "Fallout is one of our biggest priorities today," Bethesda wrote. "Fallout 5 remains our long-range destination, and we have multiple Fallout projects in active development right now." The studio then addressed the remasters directly: "We also know many players want to revisit previous Fallout experiences. While we're not announcing any dates today, we have been working on remasters for both Fallout 3 and Fallout: New Vegas." The phrasing "have been working on" suggests both remasters are past the early conceptual phase, though the explicit absence of dates signals that neither is close to a shipping window.The most notable reveal may be the Obsidian collaboration. Bethesda confirmed it is "teaming up with original New Vegas devs, Obsidian" on a separate, unannounced Fallout project. The blog post did not specify whether this is a full new title, a standalone expansion, or something else entirely, nor did it clarify the project's scope or development stage. Obsidian, now owned by Xbox, developed the original Fallout: New Vegas in 2010 under a tight 18-month production timeline and has not worked on the franchise since.On the Fallout 5 front, the blog post offers no new specifics beyond reaffirming it as a "long-range destination." Todd Howard has previously indicated the game will be directly impacted by the events of the Amazon Prime Fallout TV show, but the blog post does not elaborate on timeline, setting, or development milestones. The phrasing suggests Fallout 5 sits behind The Elder Scrolls VI in the studio's production queue, which the same blog post described as Bethesda's "primary development focus today, with the majority of our team currently working on" it.Bethesda also noted it is "planning something special" for the Fallout franchise's 30th anniversary in 2027, without offering details. Whether that anniversary event involves one of the confirmed projects or something separate remains unaddressed.What the blog post establishes, in concrete terms, is the existence of at least four distinct Fallout projects in some stage of active development: the Fallout 3 remaster, the New Vegas remaster, Fallout 5, and the unnamed Obsidian collaboration. What it does not provide is any indication of release sequencing, the technical scope of the remasters, or which internal teams or partner studios are handling each project. The confirmation resolves the question of whether these projects exist. It leaves open nearly everything else.A NOTE FROM BETHESDA GAME STUDIOSWe love making these worlds as much as you love playing in them. Today, we want to share what's next for Bethesda Game Studios and what you can expect from us in the years ahead.For forty years, we've built games that have entertained almost… pic.twitter.com/slD4pMWqW1— Bethesda Game Studios (@BethesdaStudios) July 17, 2026Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

Entertainment.title: Future's ‘The Real Me’ Lands His 12th No. 1 Album on the Billboard 200
Entertainment.text: SummaryFuture's The Real Me debuts atop the Billboard 200 with 131,000 equivalent album units, driven overwhelmingly by streamingThe achievement gives him 12 No. 1 albums, surpassing Eminem and trailing only Drake, Taylor Swift, JAY-Z, and The Beatles overallThe project is Future's first solo release since his pair of collaborative chart-toppers with Metro Boomin in 2024Future's The Real Me debuts at No. 1 on the Billboard 200, earning the Atlanta rapper his 12th chart-topping album and further entrenching his position among the most commercially dominant figures in hip-hop history. The album arrives atop the July 25-dated chart with 131,000 equivalent album units earned in the United States in the tracking week ending July 16, according to Luminate.The bulk of that total was powered by streaming. Streaming equivalent album units accounted for 118,000 of the 131,000 figure, translating to 120.29 million on-demand official streams and earning the album a simultaneous No. 1 debut on the Top Streaming Albums chart. Album sales contributed 13,000 units, good for a No. 9 debut on Top Album Sales. The project was made available across multiple formats, including a standard 11-track download edition, a 22-track streaming edition, a 21-track CD across two editions (including a signed version), and a 13-track vinyl across four variants.With a 12th Billboard 200 leader, Future now solely holds the record for the third-most No. 1 albums among rap acts, moving past Eminem's 11. Across all genres, only The Beatles (19), Drake and Taylor Swift (both at 15), and JAY-Z (14) have reached the top more frequently. The milestone adds another data point to a chart run that has defined hip-hop's streaming era, with Future's No. 1 streak stretching back over a decade. The Real Me is Future's first solo studio project since his consecutive No. 1 collaborative albums with Metro Boomin in 2024, We Don't Trust You and We Still Don't Trust You. The new album was announced on June 15, with its July 9 release date confirmed 10 days later. Its lead single, "Radio," dropped on June 26 and has since reached the top 25 on both Hot Rap Songs and Hot R&B/Hip-Hop Songs.Elsewhere on the latest Billboard 200, five former No. 1 albums follow Future in the top six: Olivia Rodrigo's you seem pretty sad for a girl so in love holds at No. 2 with 96,000 units, Morgan Wallen's I'm the Problem rises to No. 3, Ella Langley's Dandelion sits at No. 4, Noah Kahan's The Great Divide climbs to No. 5, and Drake's ICEMAN falls to No. 6 with 61,000. The Rolling Stones also enter the top 10, debuting at No. 7 with Foreign Tongues (53,000 units) to extend their all-time record to 39 Billboard 200 top 10 entries. Michael Jackson's Thriller holds steady at No. 8 with 41,000 units, while the Heated Rivalry soundtrack skates in at No. 9 with 41,000 units following the release of its CD and vinyl editions, marking the first TV series soundtrack to debut in the Billboard 200 top 10 in over a decade. Morgan Wallen's One Thing at a Time rounds out the chart's upper tier, rising from No. 11 to No. 10 with 37,000 units.Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

Entertainment.title: The Vans Skate Loafer 53 Crepe Disguises Skatepark Grip as 1950s Refinement
Entertainment.text: Name: Vans Skate Loafer 53 CrepeColorway: Brown, BlackSKU: VN000Z3QEMV, VN000Z3QFSTMSRP: TBCRelease Date: TBCThe Vans Skate Loafer 53 Crepe is the brand's latest entry in a growing lineage of shoes that refuse to pick a lane. Rooted in the clean, pared-back profile of a 1950s penny loafer, the silhouette re-emerges here with a full skate-specific toolkit underneath, blending vintage slip-on charm with the kind of reinforced construction Vans has spent decades engineering for the board.On the surface, the Skate Loafer 53 Crepe reads as almost deceptively simple. A suede upper provides a soft, textured finish across both the black and brown colorways, with leather reinforcement adding structure where the shoe needs it most. The silhouette stays true to the original loafer blueprint: low-profile, laceless, and built around an effortless on-off fit. A subtle 5-checker flag label sits at the collar, one of the few outward signals that this is a Vans shoe at all.Beneath that restrained exterior, the engineering tells a different story. The outsole runs on SickStick rubber in Vans' signature waffle pattern, a tread design the brand has deployed since '66 and one that continues to set the baseline for grip on a skateboard deck. A vulcanized sole wraps the construction together, delivering the thin-profile board feel and flexibility that skaters depend on for precision footwork. Inside, PopCush insoles handle the impact side, engineered to absorb landings without deadening the connection between foot and board. Reinforced skate construction runs throughout, targeting the high-wear zones that would shred a standard dress loafer within weeks.The result is a shoe that lives credibly in two worlds. The loafer has been quietly gaining traction in skate-adjacent circles over the past several years, as brands and riders alike have moved away from purely technical aesthetics and toward silhouettes that work just as well off the board. Vans' Style 53 sits at the center of that shift, carrying an archive pedigree that traces back through multiple iterations, including collaborative releases that helped establish the loafer as a legitimate entry in the skate shoe vocabulary. This latest "53 Crepe" version strips the concept to its essentials: premium materials, no-nonsense skate tech, and a silhouette that can move from a session to dinner without a costume change.Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

Entertainment.title: ‘God of War’ TV Series Recasts Kratos
Entertainment.text: SummaryLead actor Ryan Hurst departs the live-action God of War series after sustaining a torn bicep during a stuntAmazon MGM Studios and Sony Pictures Television plan to recast Kratos and reshoot four fully completed episodesProduction aims to resume in mid-October following a hiatus to secure a replacement for the Spartan warriorAmazon’s highly anticipated live-action God of War television series encountered a major production setback this week. Lead actor Ryan Hurst officially exited the role of Kratos after suffering a severe bicep tear while performing an on-set stunt. The injury required immediate surgery and mandates a prolonged recovery period. Because Hurst needs four to six months to rehabilitate the muscle, Amazon MGM Studios and Sony Pictures Television opted to move forward with a new lead rather than delay the massive production.Recasting a lead actor mid-shoot remains an exceptionally rare and costly maneuver in premium television. Hurst had already completed filming for four full episodes in Vancouver. The actor previously underwent a grueling physical transformation to embody the iconic Spartan and gained 40 pounds of muscle for the part. He also holds a distinct connection to the PlayStation franchise after voicing Thor in the critically acclaimed God of War Ragnarök video game.The creative team must now discard the existing footage and reshoot all four episodes from scratch. Artificial Intelligence.title: EngineAI's 1.73-Meter T800 Robot Is the Fighting Machine Joining the World's First Humanoid Combat League
Artificial Intelligence.text: SummaryEngineAI's T800 pairs 450 N·m burst-torque joints with a real-time visual feedback system that lets it read, decide, and strike autonomously in full-contact combatThe robot's full metal chassis uses aerospace-grade aluminum-magnesium alloy, centimeter-level positioning, and high-precision orientation recognition to stay controlled through heavy exchangesEngineAI has opened the T800's software and hardware interfaces to all 32 qualifying teams, turning its new URKL fighting league into a live stress test for embodied AI developmentEngineAI's T800 humanoid robot stepped into the ring for the first time on July 16 at the Nanshan Cultural & Sports Center in Shenzhen, kicking off the EngineAI URKL Global Humanoid Robot Free-Fighting League. Standing at 1.73 meters tall and built around a full metal chassis of aerospace-grade aluminum-magnesium alloy, the T800 is not a lab demo or a trade-show novelty. It is a full-sized, full-contact fighting platform, and URKL is the competitive infrastructure EngineAI has built to push its hardware and intelligence systems to the limit in real physical collisions.The T800's joint system delivers 450 N·m of high-burst torque, giving the robot enough explosive power to execute techniques like a rising uppercut, a roundhouse kick, or a rapid recovery from being knocked flat. That torque figure matters because full-contact humanoid combat is not simply about landing a single blow. The engineering challenge, as EngineAI frames it, is sustaining the full cycle of movement, attack, defense, and recovery while maintaining coordination under high-dynamic pressure. Every action the T800 takes in the ring feeds through a real-time visual feedback loop spanning perception, decision, and execution. In practical terms, the robot tracks its opponent, reads intent, and commits to attack, evasion, or counter-strike autonomously. EngineAI describes the progression as moving the T800 from "able to fight" to "knowing how to fight."Structurally, the T800's aluminum-magnesium alloy chassis is engineered for repeated impact resistance, while centimeter-level positioning and high-precision orientation recognition keep the robot's movements controlled and accurate through sustained exchanges. EngineAI's broader system architecture stacks three layers: an impact-resistant physical body, a "cerebellar" motion intelligence layer handling dynamic full-body control, and a "cortical" cognitive intelligence layer managing tactical decision-making and strategic adaptation. The company positions this integrated stack as the blueprint for what it calls an "agent with power and brain," where hardware structure, control systems, and training algorithms are collaboratively optimized inside real combat conditions rather than simulated environments.Crucially, the T800 is not a closed system. EngineAI has opened both software and hardware interfaces to all participating URKL teams, supporting secondary development. This open architecture decouples algorithm iteration from hardware constraints, letting teams independently optimize visual perception loops, tactical decision-making, and precise full-body control. It is a deliberate break from the "black box" model that has historically limited collaborative progress in robotics, and it turns every bout in the league into a live dataset for the broader embodied AI ecosystem. The organizing committee has also announced that the season's core code will be released as open source, meaning optimizations forged in competition become public assets for the industry to reuse and iterate on.The opening night delivered proof of concept. Two in-house EngineAI teams ran a full-contact exhibition to demonstrate the rule set and refereeing criteria, followed immediately by the Round of 32. The marquee bout saw "Bullfighter," in dark-armor plating, edge out "White Eagle" 3-2 across five close-quarters rounds. The league drew over 200 registrations globally, with 32 teams advancing through open qualifiers. Qualifying squads represent China, the United States, Poland, and Singapore, among other countries. The tournament format runs through four gauntlet rounds: Open Qualifier, Round of 32, Group Stage, and Grand Finals, using a hybrid of group double round-robin and double-elimination brackets.The EngineAI URKL is now advancing through its group stage, with elimination rounds and the Grand Finals still ahead. Teams, algorithm labs, and developers worldwide can follow the league's progression and explore participation through EngineAI's official channels.Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

Science & Technology.title: The Volkswagen x n+ E-Bike Brings Automotive Safety Tech to Urban Cycling With Smart View System
Science & Technology.text: SummaryVolkswagen and premium e-bike specialist n+ have launched a new range of licensed electric bicycles loaded with automotive-grade safety technologyThe release introduces a Smart View ecosystem that integrates a radar-activated rear camera and a handlebar-mounted display for active blind-spot monitoringSafety hardware extends to connected wearables including a Bluetooth-linked crash-detection helmet and smart glasses that project an augmented navigation interfaceVolkswagen and premium manufacturer n+ have introduced a new lineup of licensed electric bicycles designed to bridge the gap between automotive safety and urban micromobility. Prioritizing rider awareness over raw speed or motor power, the new Sport and Crossover models utilize a sophisticated network of sensors and cameras. The initiative aims to help cyclists navigate congested city streets safely while giving motorists clearer visual cues of the rider's intentions.The core of the technology suite is a proprietary system branded as Smart View. A high-definition rear-facing camera pairs with integrated radar sensors to actively monitor approaching traffic. Real-time video feeds and proximity alerts are delivered directly to a cockpit-mounted screen. The setup allows riders to check their blind spots without ever needing to turn their heads away from the road ahead.Automotive inspiration continues with a radical approach to bicycle lighting. A full-length LED strip embedded directly into the frame serves as a constant daytime running light. The intelligent lighting array reacts dynamically to riding behavior, glowing bright red during deceleration and flashing amber to signal upcoming turns. The design ensures other commuters can easily predict directional changes.The protective ecosystem is completed by a suite of connected wearables. A specialized Smart Helmet synchronizes its lighting with the bike signals and features built-in crash detection to automatically notify emergency contacts after a severe impact. Complementing the helmet is a pair of smart glasses developed by engineers with experience creating head-mounted displays for military pilots. The eyewear projects speed, battery data and navigation instructions straight into the rider's field of view.Priced to compete in the premium sector, the Sport models start at roughly $5,300 USD, while the helmet and smart glasses cost an additional $670 USD each. Peter Jost, CEO of Volkswagen Accessories, noted that integrating systems commonly known from the automotive world demonstrates how safety measures can evolve meaningfully for modern cyclists.
